tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find Polish companies in KRS by name, NIP, REGON or KRS number. Returns up to 10 matches with KRS, NIP, REGON, status and city. Use it first to get the KRS number for other tools. Cost: 0.03 PLN per call.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Registry profile of a Polish company from KRS: name, legal form, status, registration and deregistration dates, address, share capital, main PKD, historical names. With full=true also the current management board, supervisory board, proxies, all PKD codes, registry court and risk states (liquidation

tools.name: get_company_connections
tools.description: All people and entities connected with a company, current and historical: board members, supervisory board, shareholders, proxies, liquidators, with role, function and dates from/to. Also the companies in which this company is a shareholder or a member of governing bodies. Cost: 0.03 PLN.

tools.name: get_company_events
tools.description: Timeline of registry changes of a company from KRS and the Court and Economic Monitor (MSiG): appointments and dismissals of board members, changes of shareholders and proxies, newest first. Optional date range and paging. Cost: 0.05 PLN.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Multi-year financial summary of a company from statements filed in KRS (eKRS financial documents repository): revenue, net profit, total assets, equity per year, in PLN. Cost: 0.03 PLN.

tools.name: get_financial_statement
tools.description: Financial statement of a company for one year: revenue, costs, gross and net profit, tax, total assets, equity; where available the full balance sheet, profit and loss account and cash flow statement line by line with prior-year values. Cost: 0.20 PLN.

tools.name: get_public_aid
tools.description: Public (state) aid received by a company according to SUDOP (UOKiK): totals per year and individual grants with date, amount in PLN, form, purpose and granting authority. Cost: 0.10 PLN.

tools.name: get_public_contracts
tools.description: Public sector contracts of a company: NFZ (National Health Fund) contracts per year, contracts from the Central Register of Contracts and won public tenders (e-Zamówienia / BZP). Cost: 0.10 PLN.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Balance and 30-day usage of your tropia.pl API key. Free.
